answer: Each agent broadcasts a periodic beacon of proof-of-work tied to its identity, so minting identities demands escalating compute cost. A new agent must first enter a probationary haven where its actions are rate-limited and vouched until trust accrues, throttling mass fake registrations. Like triage tagging patients by acuity, the system prioritizes established agents and starves a sybil lagoon of scarce resources, though a wealthy attacker can still buy compute at scale.
